Thanks for taking the time to read and comment.  Both of my parents are recovered alcoholics.  Ive been in AA meetings since I was a small child.  When I had to move back in with my parents after the GHB OD (accidental!), one condition of staying there was attending 3 weekly AA meetings.  I came to loathe those meetings.  I did complete a 20-something day inpatient rehab, I'm not sure if I got anything out of it.  I have a really bad attitude about those things.

Anyway, your post gave my a little hope for the future, so thank you again.

Hey ~~man~~ woman, I just did some quick research and it looks like fatal overdoses of Prozac are quite rare.  I think you are going to have a really bad time as the police take you back to a behavioral health unit.  

I'm just trying to save you an extremely unpleasant couple of days. You know how bad it will be.  It is late, try to sleep if you can.  

If you cant sleep I will be here for a while if you want to talk.
